# Reifiable generic bound and invariant class token

The public final instance entry `<T extends Carrier<?>> T get(Class<T>)`
retains a complete unary carrier whose own element has a known nominal bound.
No token content predicts the returned object: the independently authored
provider may return null, another carrier subtype, or a value changed by its
callback. Raw, typed, discarded and subsequently narrowed results retain the
actual call, partial provider fields, exception and Error identity, and later
checked reads.

Both source and SDK modes compile every recovered Java 8 unit and preserve all
original identities, metadata, Exceptions and helper roles. The frozen caller
checks 64 fresh JVM cases twice. Eight Signature-only controls preserve Code;
eight independently compiled wrong programs must be detected by that caller.
Only authored fixture code executes.
